name: legacy-adapter
description: Scaffold a transitional resource wrapper for an existing shell-backed implementation that still needs migration or deprecation.

RESOURCE_PORTABILITY_TIER.description: Portability tier for the generated scaffold.

LEGACY_ADAPTER_OWNER.description: Owner responsible for the adapter decision.

LEGACY_ADAPTER_DECISION_DEADLINE.description: Date by which the adapter should be migrated, blueprinted, or deprecated.

LEGACY_ADAPTER_FINAL_DISPOSITION.description: Planned end state for the adapter.

LEGACY_ADAPTER_NOTES.description: Short note explaining why the adapter still exists.
LEGACY_ADAPTER_NOTES.default: Transitional shell-backed resource awaiting explicit migration or deprecation.

platformExpectations: Legacy adapters are temporary. They should not become the long-term default resource shape.
Every generated adapter should carry migration or deprecation ownership and a target date.
